notes: Shopify store with Searchspring-powered grids, same site/method as prior Home-Decor pass (notes/39.md). Access: direct HTTP fetch, no blocking; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic /search disallow, so live site search was not queried, per robots.txt). Navigation discovery: the site's top-level header nav has a 'SALE' dropdown containing a 'By Category' section (Sale Decor, Sale Dining, Sale Furniture, and 'All Sale' view-all at /collections/sale-all-sale), plus a separate featured-image tile inside that SAME dropdown that is captioned, on-page, literally 'Clearance' and links to /collections/clearance -- confirmed by fetching /collections/clearance directly: both the page <title> and the on-page H1 read 'Clearance'. This is the site's OWN taxonomy using the exact target term, not an inferred label, so it clears the Sale-vs-Clearance test directly (no MANUAL REVIEW flag needed). IMPORTANT OVERLAP FINDING: /collections/clearance and /collections/sale-all-sale ('All Sale') were compared product-by-product via products.json (94 products each) and found to be an EXACT alias -- identical 94-product id sets. The canonical URL recorded below is /collections/clearance because that is the page the site itself labels 'Clearance' (a stricter, more specific taxonomy signal than the generic 'All Sale' page it happens to duplicate); /collections/sale-all-sale itself was NOT recorded as a separate row since it is the same listing under the generic 'Sale' label. The by-category sale pages (Sale Decor 16, Sale Dining 9, Sale Furniture 52 -- summing to 77 of the 94, the remainder presumably split across Pottery/Lighting/Bath/Rugs sale sub-pages not exposed in the live nav) are captioned 'Sale Decor' / 'Sale Dining' / 'Sale Furniture' in the menu -- generic Sale wording with no clearance/outlet/final/last-chance signal -- so per the brief's explicit Sale-vs-Clearance rule they were EXCLUDED as ordinary promotional sale pages, not Clearance. Other sitemap-only handles (store-clearance-extention, the-long-clearance-weekend-event, a-mid-winter-wink-sale-styles, jonathan-adler-two-day-sale, furniture-sale-2023-eligible-markdowns, sale-deals-under-50, sale-rugs, sale-bath, sale-category-bedding, sale-by-category-lighting/pottery/bath/bedding-bath) were checked against the live header/footer HTML and are NOT linked anywhere in current navigation -- orphaned past-promotion collections still indexed by Shopify's sitemap but not part of the site's current taxonomy, so excluded. Confirmed /collections/clearance is a real product-listing grid (ss-collection-snap.js Searchspring integration), not an editorial/coupon page.
